name: double quoted comment
source:
env:
  - name: SAMPLE
    value: "literal" # trailing comment

name: single quoted comment
source:
env:
  - name: SAMPLE
    value: 'it''s literal' # trailing comment

name: yaml 1.2 plain strings
source:
env:
  - name: YES_VALUE
    value: yes
  - name: NO_VALUE
    value: no
  - name: ON_VALUE
    value: on
  - name: OFF_VALUE
    value: off

name: quoted delimiters and hash
source:
env:
  - name: SAMPLE
    value: "a: b # literal"

name: non-string scalars omitted
source:
env:
  - name: BOOLEAN
    value: true
  - name: NUMBER
    value: 42
  - name: NULL_VALUE
    value: null
  - name: TEXT
    value: available
